description.en: Given the root of a binary tree, return its height (number of edges on the longest path from root to leaf). An empty tree has height -1 (or 0 if counting nodes).
description.hi: Binary tree ka root diya gaya hai, uski height return karo (root se leaf tak sabse lamba path mein edges ki sankhya). Empty tree ki height -1 hai (ya 0 agar nodes count kar rahe ho).

explanation.en: The longest path is 3->20->15 or 3->20->7 with 2 edges
explanation.hi: Sabse lamba path 3->20->15 ya 3->20->7 hai jisme 2 edges hain

hints.en: Height = 1 + max(height(left), height(right)). Base case: null node returns -1.
hints.hi: Height = 1 + max(height(left), height(right)). Base case: null node -1 return karta hai.

approach.en: Recursively compute: if root is null, return -1. Otherwise return 1 + max(height(left), height(right)).
approach.hi: Recursively compute karo: agar root null hai, -1 return karo. Warna 1 + max(height(left), height(right)) return karo.

description.en: Given the root of a binary tree, return the total number of nodes in the tree.
description.hi: Binary tree ka root diya gaya hai, tree mein total nodes ki sankhya return karo.

hints.en: countNodes(root) = 1 + countNodes(left) + countNodes(right). Base: null returns 0.
hints.hi: countNodes(root) = 1 + countNodes(left) + countNodes(right). Base: null 0 return karta hai.

approach.en: Base case: null returns 0. Recursive case: 1 + countNodes(left) + countNodes(right).
approach.hi: Base case: null 0 return karta hai. Recursive case: 1 + countNodes(left) + countNodes(right).

description.en: Given the root of a binary tree, return the inorder traversal of its nodes' values (left, root, right).
description.hi: Binary tree ka root diya gaya hai, nodes ke values ka inorder traversal return karo (left, root, right).

explanation.en: Left subtree first, then root, then right
explanation.hi: Pehle left subtree, phir root, phir right

hints.en: Recurse left, add root to result, recurse right.
hints.hi: Left recurse karo, root result mein add karo, right recurse karo.

approach.en: Recursively traverse left subtree, add root value, traverse right subtree.
approach.hi: Recursively left subtree traverse karo, root value add karo, right subtree traverse karo.

code.python:
def inorder_traversal(root):
    result = []
    def helper(node):
        if not node: return
        helper(node.left)
        result.append(node.val)
        helper(node.right)
    helper(root)
    return result

description.en: Given the root of a binary tree, invert/mirror the tree and return its root.
description.hi: Binary tree ka root diya gaya hai, tree ko invert/mirror karo aur uska root return karo.

explanation.en: Swap left and right children at every node
explanation.hi: Har node par left aur right children swap karo

explanation.en: Left becomes right and vice versa
explanation.hi: Left right ban jaata hai aur vice versa

hints.en: At each node, swap left and right children, then recursively invert both subtrees.
hints.hi: Har node par left aur right children swap karo, phir dono subtrees recursively invert karo.

approach.en: Base case: null returns null. Swap left and right children, then recursively invert each subtree.
approach.hi: Base case: null null return karta hai. Left aur right children swap karo, phir har subtree ko recursively invert karo.

code.python:
def invert_tree(root):
    if not root:
        return None
    root.left, root.right = root.right, root.left
    invert_tree(root.left)
    invert_tree(root.right)
    return root

description.en: Given a binary tree, determine if it is height-balanced. A height-balanced binary tree is one in which the left and right subtrees of every node differ in height by no more than 1.
description.hi: Binary tree diya gaya hai, determine karo ki yeh height-balanced hai ya nahi. Height-balanced binary tree mein har node ke left aur right subtrees ki height mein 1 se zyada ka antar nahi hota.

explanation.en: Heights differ by at most 1 at every node
explanation.hi: Har node par heights mein zyada se zyada 1 ka antar hai

explanation.en: Left subtree height is 3, right subtree height is 1
explanation.hi: Left subtree height 3 hai, right subtree height 1 hai

hints.en: Compute height at each node. If |left_height - right_height| > 1 at any node, return false. Optimize by passing height back up.
hints.hi: Har node par height compute karo. Agar kisi bhi node par |left_height - right_height| > 1 hai, false return karo. Height upar return karke optimize karo.

approach.en: Helper function returns height if balanced, -1 if unbalanced. At each node: compute left and right heights. If either returns -1, or abs(lh-rh) > 1, return -1. Otherwise return 1+max(lh,rh).
approach.hi: Helper function balanced hone par height return karta hai, unbalanced hone par -1. Har node par: left aur right heights compute karo. Agar koi -1 return kare, ya abs(lh-rh) > 1 ho, -1 return karo. Warna 1+max(lh,rh) return karo.

description.en: Given a binary tree and two nodes p and q, find their Lowest Common Ancestor (LCA). The LCA is the deepest node that has both p and q as descendants.
description.hi: Binary tree aur do nodes p aur q diye gaye hain, unka Lowest Common Ancestor (LCA) dhundo. LCA woh deepest node hai jiske dono p aur q descendants hain.

explanation.en: 5 is an ancestor of 4, so LCA is 5
explanation.hi: 5, 4 ka ancestor hai, isliye LCA 5 hai

hints.en: If root is null, or root is p or q, return root. Recurse left and right. If both return non-null, root is LCA. Else return the non-null result.
hints.hi: Agar root null hai, ya root p ya q hai, root return karo. Left aur right recurse karo. Agar dono non-null return karein, root LCA hai. Warna non-null result return karo.

approach.en: If root is null or equals p or q, return root. Recurse on left and right. If both return non-null, current node is LCA. If only one is non-null, propagate that up.
approach.hi: Agar root null hai ya p ya q ke barabar hai, root return karo. Left aur right par recurse karo. Agar dono non-null return karein, current node LCA hai. Agar sirf ek non-null hai, use upar propagate karo.

description.en: Implement insert and search operations for a Binary Search Tree. Insert a value into the BST and search for a value returning true/false.
description.hi: Binary Search Tree ke liye insert aur search operations implement karo. BST mein value insert karo aur value search karo true/false return karte hue.

hints.en: For insert: if val < root, go left; else go right. Create new node when null. For search: same logic, return true when found.
hints.hi: Insert ke liye: agar val < root hai, left jao; warna right. Null milne par naya node banao. Search ke liye: same logic, milne par true return karo.

approach.en: Insert: compare val with root. If less, recurse left; if greater, recurse right; create node when null. Search: same comparison logic, return true when root.val == val.
approach.hi: Insert: val ko root se compare karo. Agar kam hai, left recurse karo; zyada hai to right; null milne par node banao. Search: same comparison logic, root.val == val hone par true return karo.

description.en: Given the root of a binary tree, determine if it is a valid binary search tree (BST). A valid BST has: left subtree nodes strictly less than root, right subtree nodes strictly greater, and both subtrees are also valid BSTs.
description.hi: Binary tree ka root diya gaya hai, determine karo ki yeh valid binary search tree (BST) hai ya nahi. Valid BST mein: left subtree nodes strictly root se kam, right subtree nodes strictly zyada, aur dono subtrees bhi valid BSTs hain.

hints.en: Pass min and max bounds. For left subtree, max = root.val. For right subtree, min = root.val.
hints.hi: Min aur max bounds pass karo. Left subtree ke liye max = root.val. Right subtree ke liye min = root.val.

approach.en: Pass min/max bounds. If node val <= min or >= max, invalid. For left, update max = node.val. For right, update min = node.val. Base case: null is valid.
approach.hi: Min/max bounds pass karo. Agar node val <= min ya >= max hai, invalid. Left ke liye max = node.val update karo. Right ke liye min = node.val update karo. Base case: null valid hai.

hints.en: At each node, diameter passing through it = left_height + right_height. Track global maximum.

description.en: Given the root of a binary tree and an integer targetSum, return true if the tree has a root-to-leaf path such that adding all values along the path equals targetSum.
description.hi: Binary tree ka root aur ek integer targetSum diya gaya hai, true return karo agar tree mein ek root-to-leaf path hai jisme saare values ka sum targetSum ke barabar ho.

explanation.hi: Sum 5 wala koi root-to-leaf path nahi hai

hints.en: Subtract root value from targetSum, recurse to children. Base case: leaf node with remaining sum == 0 returns true.
hints.hi: Root value targetSum se subtract karo, children par recurse karo. Base case: remaining sum == 0 wala leaf node true return karta hai.

approach.en: If null, return false. If leaf (no children), return root.val == targetSum. Otherwise recurse with targetSum - root.val on both children, return OR of results.
approach.hi: Agar null hai, false return karo. Agar leaf (koi children nahi), return root.val == targetSum. Warna dono children par targetSum - root.val ke saath recurse karo, results ka OR return karo.

title.hi: Binary Tree Ko Serialize aur Deserialize Karo

description.en: Design an algorithm to serialize and deserialize a binary tree. Serialization converts a tree to a string, and deserialization reconstructs the tree from that string.
description.hi: Binary tree ko serialize aur deserialize karne ka algorithm design karo. Serialization tree ko string mein convert karta hai, aur deserialization us string se tree wapas banata hai.

explanation.hi: Null markers ke saath preorder traversal

hints.en: Use preorder traversal for serialization. Use 'null' for empty nodes. For deserialization, split by comma and reconstruct using a queue/index.
hints.hi: Serialization ke liye preorder traversal use karo. Empty nodes ke liye 'null' use karo. Deserialization ke liye comma se split karo aur queue/index use karke reconstruct karo.

approach.en: Serialize: preorder traversal, use 'null' for null nodes, comma-separated. Deserialize: split by comma into queue, recursively build tree using preorder: take first value, if 'null' return null, else create node with left=deserialize(), right=deserialize().
approach.hi: Serialize: preorder traversal, null nodes ke liye 'null' use karo, comma-separated. Deserialize: comma se queue mein split karo, preorder use karke recursively tree banao: pehla value lo, agar 'null' hai to null return karo, warna node banao left=deserialize(), right=deserialize() ke saath.
